items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: So he took us one day on up to the house on the ramparts, see, 20, 23, they call it Danny and I. And they showed each one of us some chord structure.

ctx.x: Yeah. And was your father's, you know, when your father tried to teach you, was he really strict about trying to teach you? No, he wasn't strict.

He had had came about, they had to get through there, you know, laying against the wall or something, doing something. My other brothers used to fool with it, and I would fool with it more, because my mom would tell him, you know, we weren't supposed to fool with it, but we'd ask permission. So he took us one day on up to the house on the ramparts, see, 20, 23, they call it Danny and I. And they showed each one of us some chord structure. I think it was three or four days. And he found out that I was the only one…
Yeah. You were playing violins in bands? No, no, no, no. Because a lot of people learned on violins, I find.
